steps.tl: Pindutin ang menu sa kaliwang taas para makita ang lahat ng serbisyo ng Barangay.
steps.en: Tap the menu at the top left to see every service of the Barangay.

steps.tl: Piliin ang serbisyong kailangan mo, halimbawa Ambulansya, Appointment o Reklamo.
steps.en: Choose the service you need, for example Ambulance, Appointment or Complaints.

steps.tl: Sa emergency, pindutin ang pulang SOS sa gitna para tumawag agad.
steps.en: In an emergency, tap the red SOS in the middle to call right away.

steps.tl: Sa Account makikita ang profile mo, ang Barangay ID mo, at ang pag-verify ng account.
steps.en: In Account you will find your profile, your Barangay ID, and account verification.

steps.tl: Tuwing Pasko may mahinang tugtog. Pindutin ang pulang music button sa kaliwang ibaba para patayin o buksan ito.
steps.en: At Christmas there is soft music. Tap the red music button at the bottom left to turn it off or on.

steps.tl: Kung emergency, tumawag muna sa numerong ito para mas mabilis ang sagot.
steps.en: In an emergency, call this number first so you get an answer faster.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-request ng Emergency kung kailangan agad ng ambulansya.
steps.en: Tap Request an Emergency if you need the ambulance right away.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan ng pasyente, ang nangyari, at kung saan siya susunduin.
steps.en: Write the patient's name, what happened, and where to pick them up.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Makikita mo ang status ng request sa MGA REQUEST KO.
steps.en: Tap Send. You can follow the request under MY REQUESTS.

steps.tl: Hindi emergency (halimbawa dialysis o check-up)? Pindutin ang Mag-schedule at pumili ng petsa at oras.
steps.en: Not an emergency (for example dialysis or a check-up)? Tap Schedule and pick a date and time.

steps.tl: Piliin ang serbisyo, halimbawa Barangay Clearance. Wala ka pang account? Piliin ang Rehistro sa Malineng Portal (kahit hindi naka-login) para mag-iskedyul ng pagpunta sa Barangay Hall; ang staff ang magre-register sa iyo at magbibigay ng Barangay ID.
steps.en: Choose the service, for example Barangay Clearance. No account yet? Choose Registration in the Malineng Portal (even when not logged in) to book a visit to the Barangay Hall; the staff registers you and gives you the Barangay ID.

steps.tl: Pumili ng petsa ng pagkuha. Lunes hanggang Biyernes lang.
steps.en: Pick the date you will pick it up. Monday to Friday only.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-book ang Appointment. Dalhin ang valid ID sa Barangay Hall sa napiling petsa.
steps.en: Tap Book Appointment. Bring a valid ID to the Barangay Hall on that date.

steps.tl: Sa TRACKING makikita mo kung handa na ang dokumento mo.
steps.en: Under TRACKING you can see when your document is ready.

steps.tl: Lalabas dito ang Barangay ID mo kapag verified na ang account mo, kasama ang ID number mo (MG-####-####), ang kasarian at civil status mo, at ang pirma ng Punong Barangay. Lagyan ng sarili mong pirma ang blangkong linya pagkatapos i-print. May QR code ito na ini-scan ng Barangay.
steps.en: Your Barangay ID shows here once your account is verified, with your ID number (MG-####-####), your sex and civil status, and the Punong Barangay's signature. Sign the blank line yourself after printing. It has a QR code the Barangay can scan.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-print o i-save bilang PDF para may kopya ka.
steps.en: Tap Print or save as PDF to keep a copy.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-file ng reklamo.
steps.en: Tap File a complaint.

steps.tl: Piliin ang uri ng reklamo, halimbawa ingay o alitan.
steps.en: Choose the kind of complaint, for example noise or a dispute.

steps.tl: Ikuwento ang nangyari: kailan, saan, at sino ang kasali.
steps.en: Tell what happened: when, where, and who was involved.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala sa Barangay. Pribado ang reklamo mo.
steps.en: Tap Send to the Barangay. Your complaint is private.

steps.tl: Piliin ang room: Buong Barangay, o ang Purok mo.
steps.en: Pick a room: the whole Barangay, or your own Purok.

steps.tl: I-type ang mensahe mo. Magalang na usapan lang po.
steps.en: Type your message. Please keep it respectful.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Pindutin ang mensahe ng iba para mag-react (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏). Sa Purok room, sa chat ng staff at sa Developer, makikita sa ilalim ng huling mensahe mo kung sino ang nakabasa ("Nakita ni..."). Pwede itong i-off sa Account. Nabubura ang mga mensahe pagkatapos ng 7 araw.
steps.en: Tap Send. Tap someone's message to react (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 🙏). In your Purok room, the staff chat and the Developer chat, you see under your last message who has read it ("Seen by..."). You can turn this off in Account. Messages are deleted after 7 days.

steps.tl: May tanong o problema sa app? Pindutin ito para sa pribadong chat sa Developer.
steps.en: Have a question or a problem with the app? Tap this for a private chat with the Developer.

steps.tl: Kapag verified ang account mo, may entry code ka na sa raffle. Wala ka nang ibang gagawin.
steps.en: Once your account is verified you get a raffle entry code. There is nothing else to do.

steps.tl: Gusto mong magbigay? Pindutin ang Magdonate o maging sponsor. Tatawagan ka ng Barangay.
steps.en: Want to give? Tap Donate or become a sponsor. The Barangay will call you.

steps.tl: Basahin dito ang buong paliwanag ng raffle.
steps.en: Read the full explanation of the raffle here.

title.tl: Paano bumili at magbenta sa Tindahan
title.en: How to buy and sell in the Shop

steps.tl: Maghanap ng paninda dito, o pumili ng category sa ibaba.
steps.en: Search for items here, or pick a category below.

steps.tl: Gusto mong magbenta? Pindutin ang Magbenta (Libre!).
steps.en: Want to sell? Tap Sell (Free!).

steps.tl: Magdagdag ng larawan ng paninda mo.
steps.en: Add a photo of your item.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan, presyo at maikling paglalarawan.
steps.en: Write the name, the price and a short description.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-post. Susuriin muna ito ng Barangay bago lumabas.
steps.en: Tap Post. The Barangay checks it before it appears.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Hiramin sa gamit na kailangan mo, halimbawa tent o upuan.
steps.en: Tap Borrow on the item you need, for example a tent or chairs.

steps.tl: Piliin ang petsa ng kuha at ng balik.
steps.en: Pick the pick-up date and the return date.

steps.tl: Piliin ang dami ng hihiramin.
steps.en: Choose how many you will borrow.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala ang request. Aaprubahan ito ng mga opisyal.
steps.en: Tap Send request. The officials will approve it.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pangalan mo o ang control number.
steps.en: Type your name or your control number.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-check para makita kung kasama ka sa listahan.
steps.en: Tap Check to see if you are on the list.

steps.tl: Isulat ang buong pangalan mo, ang purok at ang contact number.
steps.en: Write your full name, your purok and your contact number.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang email at password (hindi bababa sa 8 characters).
steps.en: Enter your email and a password (at least 8 characters).

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Gumawa ng Account. Buksan ang email mo at i-click ang link para ma-confirm.
steps.en: Tap Create Account. Open your email and click the link to confirm.

steps.tl: Pwede ring Google ang gamitin kung wala kang gustong tandaang password.
steps.en: You can also use Google if you do not want to remember a password.

steps.tl: Sa Account, pindutin ang Mag-selfie para ma-verify.
steps.en: In Account, tap Take a selfie to verify.

steps.tl: Basahin at lagyan ng check ang pahintulot na gamitin ng Barangay ang selfie mo.
steps.en: Read and tick the permission for the Barangay to use your selfie.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Buksan ang camera at mag-selfie (walang shades o mask). Hintayin ang approval ng Barangay.
steps.en: Tap Open camera and take a selfie (no sunglasses or mask). Wait for the Barangay to approve.

steps.tl: Dito mo mababago ang pangalan, purok, contact number, birthday, kasarian at civil status mo.
steps.en: Here you can change your name, purok, contact number, birthday, sex and civil status.

steps.tl: Pagkatapos magpalit, pindutin ang Ipadala para sa approval. Ang Barangay ang mag-aaprub; hangga't hindi pa, ang lumang detalye ang ginagamit. Makikita mo rito kung naaprubahan o hindi.
steps.en: After you change something, tap Send for approval. The Barangay approves it; until then your old details stay. You will see here if it was approved or not.

steps.tl: Nahihirapan sa pag-register, selfie o profile? Pindutin ito para makipag-chat sa mga admin ng Barangay at sa Developer. Pribado ito.
steps.en: Having trouble with registering, the selfie or your profile? Tap this to chat with the Barangay admins and the Developer. It is private.

steps.tl: Piliin ang wika (TL o EN) at ang laki ng text (Aa) para mas madaling basahin.
steps.en: Choose the language (TL or EN) and the text size (Aa) so it is easier to read.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-logout kapag tapos ka na, lalo na sa hiniram na phone.
steps.en: Tap Log out when you are done, especially on a borrowed phone.

title.en: What to do in an emergency

steps.tl: Gulo, nakawan o aksidente? Pindutin ang TANOD. Tatawag agad ang phone mo.
steps.en: Trouble, theft or an accident? Tap TANOD. Your phone will call right away.

steps.tl: May sakit at kailangan ng doktor? Pindutin ang HEALTH CENTER.
steps.en: Someone is sick and needs a doctor? Tap HEALTH CENTER.

steps.tl: Sunog? Pindutin ang BFP (Bumbero).
steps.en: A fire? Tap BFP (the fire station).

steps.tl: Kailangan ng ambulansya? Pindutin ito para sa request ng ambulansya ng Barangay.
steps.en: Need an ambulance? Tap this to request the Barangay ambulance.

steps.tl: Para sa pambansang emergency, pindutin ang 911.
steps.en: For a national emergency, tap 911.

title.tl: Paano tingnan ang gamot sa Botika
title.en: How to check medicine at the pharmacy

steps.tl: I-type ang pangalan ng gamot na hinahanap mo.
steps.en: Type the name of the medicine you are looking for.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Meron para makita ang gamot na may stock ngayon.
steps.en: Tap In stock to see the medicine available now.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ubos para makita kung ano ang naubos na.
steps.en: Tap Out of stock to see what has run out.

title.en: How to post on the Community Board

steps.tl: Pindutin ang kahon at isulat ang gusto mong i-post sa komunidad.
steps.en: Tap the box and write what you want to share with the community.

steps.tl: Pwede kang magdagdag ng larawan.
steps.en: You can add a photo.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-post. Susuriin muna ng Barangay bago ito lumabas.
steps.en: Tap Post. The Barangay checks it before it appears.

steps.tl: Piliin ang Lahat, Purok ko, o Post ko para makita ang gusto mo.
steps.en: Choose All, My Purok, or My Posts to see what you want.

steps.tl: Pindutin ito para tumunog ang phone kapag may bagong pabatid.
steps.en: Tap this so your phone rings when there is a new announcement.

steps.tl: Para sa akin: ang mga pabatid para sa purok mo at sa buong Barangay.
steps.en: For me: announcements for your purok and the whole Barangay.

steps.tl: Lahat ng purok: makita ang mga pabatid ng ibang purok.
steps.en: All puroks: see the announcements of other puroks.

title.en: How to register for an event

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Magparehistro sa Event.
steps.en: Tap Register for an Event.

steps.tl: Isulat ang buong pangalan, purok at contact number.
steps.en: Write your full name, purok and contact number.

steps.tl: Piliin kung para saan ang pagpaparehistro, halimbawa Ayuda o Clean-up.
steps.en: Choose what you are registering for, for example Aid or Clean-up.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-register para tapusin.
steps.en: Tap Register to finish.

steps.tl: Nawawala ang gamit mo? Tingnan dito kung may nakakita na.
steps.en: Lost something? Check here if someone found it.

steps.tl: Nakakita ka ng gamit ng iba? Tingnan dito ang mga nakita.
steps.en: Found something that belongs to someone else? See the found items here.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-report para ilista ang nawawala o nakita mo, kasama ang larawan.
steps.en: Tap Report to list what you lost or found, with a photo.

steps.tl: Isulat ang mungkahi mo para sa Barangay.
steps.en: Write your suggestion for the Barangay.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Ipadala. Binabasa ito ng mga opisyal.
steps.en: Tap Send. The officials read it.

title.tl: Paano maghanap ng trabaho sa Hiring
title.en: How to find a job in Hiring

steps.tl: Maghanap ng trabaho, halimbawa helper, driver o cashier.
steps.en: Search for a job, for example helper, driver or cashier.

steps.tl: Piliin ang uri ng trabaho: Full-time, Part-time o Pana-panahon.
steps.en: Pick the kind of job: full-time, part-time or seasonal.

steps.tl: Sa Inapply ko makikita ang mga inaplayan mo.
steps.en: Under Applied you can see the jobs you applied for.

steps.tl: May negosyo ka at kailangan ng tao? Pindutin ang Mag-post.
steps.en: Have a business and need workers? Tap Post.

title.en: How to use the Skills Directory

steps.tl: Maghanap ng may skill na kailangan mo, halimbawa tubero.
steps.en: Look for someone with the skill you need, for example a plumber.

steps.tl: May skill ka? Pindutin ang Magpa-lista ng Skill para mahanap ka ng mga kabarangay.
steps.en: Have a skill? Tap List my skill so neighbours can find you.

steps.tl: Maghanap ng lugar sa Malineng, halimbawa tindahan o paaralan.
steps.en: Search for a place in Malineng, for example a shop or a school.

steps.tl: Pumili ng uri ng lugar para makita lang ang mga iyon.
steps.en: Pick a kind of place to see only those.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Nasaan ako para makita ang kinatatayuan mo sa mapa.
steps.en: Tap Where am I to see where you are on the map.

steps.tl: May negosyo o lugar na wala pa rito? Pindutin ang Mag-pin ng lugar.
steps.en: Have a business or a place that is not here yet? Tap Pin a place.

steps.tl: Piliin ang kalagayan ng proyekto: Ginagawa, Nakaplano, Tapos na o Naantala.
steps.en: Pick the status of the project: in progress, planned, done or delayed.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Tapos na para makita ang mga natapos nang proyekto. Sa bawat proyekto makikita ang larawan, badyet at progreso.
steps.en: Tap Done to see the finished projects. Each project shows its photos, budget and progress.

title.tl: Paano tingnan ang Pondo ng Barangay
title.en: How to see the Barangay Fund

steps.tl: Piliin ang taon para makita ang badyet at kung saan napunta ang pondo.
steps.en: Pick the year to see the budget and where the funds went.

steps.tl: Sa Mga gastos makikita kung saan ginastos ang pera ng Barangay.
steps.en: Under Expenses you can see where the Barangay money was spent.

steps.tl: Piliin ang purok at isulat ang address ng bahay ninyo.
steps.en: Pick your purok and write your home address.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Magdagdag ng miyembro para ilista ang bawat kasama sa bahay.
steps.en: Tap Add member to list each person in your household.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-save. Tinutulungan nito ang Barangay sa ayuda at serbisyo. Kung ang asawa mo ay naglagay din ng household, pagsasamahin ito ng Barangay para isa na lang.
steps.en: Tap Save. This helps the Barangay with aid and services. If your spouse also made a household, the Barangay will merge them into one.

title.tl: Paano sundan ang Liga at Palaro
title.en: How to follow the League and Games

steps.tl: Sa Mga laro makikita ang mga darating na laro, ang oras at ang score ng mga tapos na.
steps.en: Under Games you can see upcoming games, the time, and the scores of finished ones.

steps.tl: Sa Standings makikita ang ranggo ng mga team.
steps.en: Under Standings you can see how the teams rank.

steps.tl: Sa Teams makikita ang mga team at manlalaro. May team ang purok ninyo? Magparehistro dito.
steps.en: Under Teams you can see the teams and players. Does your purok have a team? Register it here.

steps.tl: Dito makikita ang ranggo ng mga purok ayon sa points. Ang nangunguna ay may gintong kahon.
steps.en: Here you see the ranking of the puroks by points. The leader has a gold frame.

steps.tl: Kumikita ng points ang purok sa bawat clean-up at bayanihan. Sumali para umangat ang purok mo!
steps.en: A purok earns points for every clean-up and community effort. Join in to lift your purok!

steps.tl: Dito nakalathala ang mahahalagang desisyon na inaprubahan ng mga opisyal ng Barangay.
steps.en: Here are the important decisions the Barangay officials approved.

steps.tl: Makikita ang petsa ng pag-apruba. Hindi ipinapakita dito ang halaga ng pera.
steps.en: You can see the date it was approved. The amount of money is not shown here.

title.tl: Paano makita ang bakuna ng anak mo
title.en: How to see your child's vaccines

steps.tl: Kapag naka-link ang anak mo sa account mo, makikita mo dito ang record niya. Ang BHW ang nag-uulat nito sa Health Center.
steps.en: When your child is linked to your account, you see their record here. The health worker enters it at the Health Center.

steps.tl: Sinasabi dito kung ano ang susunod na bakuna at kailan. Dalhin ang baby book sa Health Center.
steps.en: This says which vaccine is next and when. Bring the baby book to the Health Center.

title.en: How to check a Barangay ID

steps.tl: I-scan ang QR code sa Barangay ID gamit ang camera ng phone. Lalabas ang pangalan at kung valid ang ID.
steps.en: Scan the QR code on the Barangay ID with your phone camera. It shows the name and whether the ID is valid.

title.tl: Paano mag-approve ng post, paninda at trabaho
title.en: How to approve posts, listings and jobs

steps.tl: Dito lumalabas ang mga post, paninda at trabaho na naghihintay ng approval, bawat uri sa sariling listahan.
steps.en: Posts, listings and jobs waiting for approval show here, each kind in its own list.

steps.tl: Basahin ang laman, tapos pindutin ang Approve kung maayos. Lalabas ito sa residente.
steps.en: Read it, then tap Approve if it is fine. It then shows to residents.

steps.tl: Kung tatanggihan, isulat muna ang dahilan. Ito ang makikita ng nag-post.
steps.en: If you reject it, write the reason first. The poster will see it.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Tanggihan para hindi ito lumabas.
steps.en: Tap Reject so that it does not appear.

steps.tl: Sa Naghihintay makikita ang mga nag-selfie na hindi pa na-verify.
steps.en: Under Waiting you see residents who sent a selfie and are not verified yet.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang pangalan para makita ang selfie at detalye. May button na Mag-chat sa ibaba kung kailangan mo siyang kausapin sa app.
steps.en: Tap the name to see the selfie and details. There is a Chat button below if you need to talk to them in the app.

steps.tl: Kung tugma ang mukha at detalye, pindutin ang I-verify. Magkakaroon na siya ng Barangay ID.
steps.en: If the face and details match, tap Verify. They then get a Barangay ID.

steps.tl: Kung malabo o mali, piliin ang dahilan at pindutin ang I-reject. Makikita ito ng residente.
steps.en: If it is blurry or wrong, pick the reason and tap Reject. The resident will see it.

title.tl: Paano mag-register ng residente sa Hall
title.en: How to register a resident at the Hall

steps.tl: Para sa residenteng hindi marunong mag-register. Isulat ang pangalan, purok, birthday at contact number niya.
steps.en: For residents who cannot register on their own. Write their name, purok, birthday and contact number.

steps.tl: Ang contact number ang login niya. Maglagay ng pansamantalang password na ibibigay mo sa kanya. Walang email? Okay lang.
steps.en: Their contact number is the login. Set a temporary password to give them. No email? That is fine.

steps.tl: Lagyan ng check kapag nakita mo ang ID niya. Pwede mo siyang kunan ng selfie para sa litrato sa Barangay ID. Ang Developer ang magbibigay ng final review at approval; pagkatapos nito siya magiging verified.
steps.en: Tick this when you saw their ID. You can take a selfie for the Barangay ID photo. The Developer gives the final review and approval; the resident is verified after that.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Irehistro. Kopyahin ang login at password at ibigay sa kanya. Hihintayin niya ang final approval ng Developer. Sa Account, mapapalitan niya ang password.
steps.en: Tap Register. Copy the login and password and give them to the resident. They wait for the Developer's final approval. In Account they can change the password.

title.tl: Paano sagutin ang humihingi ng tulong sa setup
title.en: How to answer someone who needs help with setup

steps.tl: Dito makikita ang mga residenteng nahihirapan sa pag-register, pag-login, selfie o profile. Ang pula na Naghihintay ay wala pang sumasagot.
steps.en: Here you see residents who have trouble registering, logging in, with the selfie or the profile. The red Waiting tag means nobody has answered yet.

steps.tl: Isulat ang sagot at pindutin ang Ipadala. Sinumang admin o ang Developer ang pwedeng sumagot. Pribado ito sa kanila at sa residente.
steps.en: Write your answer and tap Send. Any admin or the Developer can answer. It is private between them and the resident.

title.tl: Paano mag-aprub ng pagbabago sa profile
title.en: How to approve a profile change

steps.tl: Dito makikita ang mga residenteng humihiling magpalit ng pangalan, purok, contact o birthday. Makikita ang dati at bagong detalye.
steps.en: Here you see residents who asked to change their name, purok, contact or birthday, with the old and new details.

steps.tl: Kung tama, pindutin ang Aprubahan. Ma-u-update agad ang profile niya at may tala sa Activity Log.
steps.en: If it is correct, tap Approve. His profile is updated right away and it is written in the Activity Log.

steps.tl: Kung mali o kulang ang patunay, piliin ang dahilan at pindutin ang I-reject. Makikita ito ng residente.
steps.en: If it is wrong or there is no proof, pick the reason and tap Reject. The resident will see it.

title.tl: Paano mag-release ng request ng ambulansya
title.en: How to release an ambulance request

steps.tl: Itakda dito kung available ang ambulansya. Ito ang nakikita ng mga residente.
steps.en: Set here whether the ambulance is available. Residents see this.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang pangalan ng driver para i-mark na hindi available (off-duty o may sakit).
steps.en: Tap a driver's name to mark them unavailable (off duty or sick).

steps.tl: Pindutin ang request na naghihintay ng approval.
steps.en: Tap the request waiting for approval.

steps.tl: Siguraduhing may napiling driver. Kung wala o hindi available, pumili ng pamalit.
steps.en: Make sure a driver is chosen. If there is none or they are unavailable, choose a substitute.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-release. Magkakaroon ng link para sa driver na ipapadala mo; siya ang magkukumpirma ng Papunta na at Tapos na.
steps.en: Tap Release. A link for the driver is made for you to send; the driver confirms On the way and Done.

steps.tl: Sa Bago makikita ang mga bagong appointment na hindi pa naaasikaso. Sa itaas, ang "Rehistro sa Malineng Portal: walang account" ay mga taong humihingi ng rehistro; pindutin ang Irehistro ngayon at pre-filled na ang form.
steps.en: Under New you see appointments that have not been handled yet. At the top, "Registration in the Malineng Portal: no account" lists people asking to be registered; tap Register now and the form is already filled in.

steps.tl: Palitan ang status habang umuusad: Natanggap, Nasa Kagawad, hanggang Ready.
steps.en: Change the status as it moves on: Received, With the Kagawad, up to Ready.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Tawagan para kausapin ang residente.
steps.en: Tap Call to talk to the resident.

title.tl: Paano mag-approve ng hiraman ng gamit

steps.tl: Sa Request makikita ang mga humihiram na naghihintay ng approval.
steps.en: Under Requests you see people borrowing who are waiting for approval.

steps.tl: Kung tama ang hiniram at petsa, pindutin ang I-release (kung ikaw na ang huling approver).
steps.en: If the items and dates are fine, tap Release (when you are the last approver).

steps.tl: Kung hindi pwede, isulat ang dahilan at pindutin ang Tanggihan.
steps.en: If it cannot be done, write the reason and tap Reject.

title.tl: Paano asikasuhin ang donasyon sa raffle

steps.tl: Dito makikita ang mga nangakong magbigay (donor at sponsor).
steps.en: Here you see the people who pledged to give (donors and sponsors).

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Tanggapin, tapos tawagan ang donor. Kapag naibigay na sa Barangay Hall, pindutin ang Natanggap na para gumawa ng resibo.
steps.en: Tap Accept, then call the donor. When it is handed in at the Barangay Hall, tap Received to make a receipt.

steps.tl: Kapag Natanggap na ang donasyon, pindutin ang Certificate of Appreciation at i-print (A4 na pahalang) kasama ng resibo. Piliin ang puting papel o ivory na papel.
steps.en: Once the donation is Received, tap Certificate of Appreciation and print it (A4 landscape) with the receipt. Choose white paper or ivory paper.

steps.tl: Sa Mga sponsor makikita at maaayos ang listahan ng sponsor na nakikita ng lahat.
steps.en: Under Sponsors you can see and manage the sponsor list everyone sees.

steps.tl: Piliin ang uri ng event para makita ang mga nagparehistro roon.
steps.en: Pick the kind of event to see who registered for it.

steps.tl: Pindutin ito para makopya ang listahan at mailipat sa spreadsheet.
steps.en: Tap this to copy the list and move it to a spreadsheet.

title.tl: Paano baguhin ang Settings ng website
title.en: How to change the website Settings

steps.tl: Dito inilalagay at inaayos ang mga opisyal na lumalabas sa Home.
steps.en: Here you add and edit the officials shown on Home.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang mga anunsyo na lumalabas sa Home. Nagpapalit ang mga ito tuwing 10 segundo. Lagyan ng petsa na 'Mawawala pagkatapos ng' para kusa itong mawala kapag tapos na ang event.
steps.en: Add the announcements shown on Home. They switch every 10 seconds. Set an 'Ends after' date so it disappears by itself when the event is over.

steps.tl: Maglagay ng alert (hal. bagyo) at i-on ang heat index.
steps.en: Put up an alert (for example a typhoon) and turn on the heat index.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang numero ng ambulansya, ang listahan ng driver at ang bayad.
steps.en: Enter the ambulance number, the list of drivers and the fee.

title.tl: Paano ayusin ang Users at Roles (Developer)
title.en: How to manage Users and Roles (Developer)

steps.tl: Pindutin ito para gumawa ng account ng opisyal (Kapitan, Secretary, BHW, atbp.).
steps.en: Tap this to create an account for an official (Kapitan, Secretary, BHW, etc.).

steps.tl: Dito makikita kung ilang miyembro ang bawat purok, at ilan sa kanila ang verified. Makikita rin ito sa Chat (sa tabi ng bawat Purok).
steps.en: Here you see how many members each purok has and how many are verified. You also see it in Chat (next to each Purok).

steps.tl: Hanapin ang user sa pangalan, purok o email.
steps.en: Find a user by name, purok or email.

steps.tl: Piliin ang Di verified para makita ang mga hindi pa verified.
steps.en: Choose Not verified to see those who are not verified yet.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang user para palitan ang role, i-suspend o palitan ang litrato sa ID.
steps.en: Tap a user to change the role, suspend, or change the photo on the ID.

title.tl: Paano itakda kung sino ang nag-aapprove (Developer)

steps.tl: Piliin ang aksyon na gusto mong ayusin, halimbawa Ambulansya.
steps.en: Choose the action you want to set up, for example Ambulance.

steps.tl: Piliin kung sino ang bawat approver, sunod-sunod: halimbawa Secretary muna, tapos Kapitan.
steps.en: Choose each approver in order: for example the Secretary first, then the Kapitan.

steps.tl: Dagdagan ng hakbang kung may dagdag na magpapasya (hanggang 3).
steps.en: Add a step if another person must decide (up to 3).

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-save ang setting. Susunod agad ang mga bagong request.
steps.en: Tap Save setting. New requests follow it right away.

title.tl: Paano ihanda at bunutin ang raffle (Developer)
title.en: How to set up and draw the raffle (Developer)

steps.tl: I-on para ipakita ang raffle sa lahat. I-off para itago ito.
steps.en: Turn on to show the raffle to everyone. Turn off to hide it.

steps.tl: Itakda ang simula, ang cutoff ng entries at ang oras ng bunutan.
steps.en: Set the start, the entry cutoff and the time of the draw.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang mga round at premyo, tapos pindutin ang I-save ang setup.
steps.en: Add the rounds and prizes, then tap Save setup.

steps.tl: Kung may na-verify na walang entry pa, pindutin ito para bigyan sila.
steps.en: If some verified people have no entry yet, tap this to give them one.

steps.tl: Sa araw ng bunutan, pindutin ang Bunutin. Isa-isa ang round, at ang major prize ang huli.
steps.en: On draw day, tap Draw. One round at a time, with the major prize last.

title.tl: Paano magdagdag ng video o ad (Developer)
title.en: How to add a video or an ad (Developer)

steps.tl: Isulat ang pamagat ng video.
steps.en: Write the title of the video.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang link (YouTube, Facebook o .mp4).
steps.en: Paste the link (YouTube, Facebook or .mp4).

steps.tl: Kung ad ito ng negosyo, isulat ang pangalan ng negosyo. Mapupunta ito sa tab na Ads. Iwanang blangko kung karaniwang video.
steps.en: If it is a business ad, write the business name. It goes to the Ads tab. Leave it empty for a normal video.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Idagdag ang link.
steps.en: Tap Add link.

steps.tl: O pumili ng video file sa phone mo (hanggang 1 minuto ang pinakamagandang haba). Pagkatapos, sa listahan sa ibaba, pindutin ang Sino ang nanood para makita kung sino ang naka-login na nanood.
steps.en: Or pick a video file on your phone (about 1 minute is best). Then, in the list below, tap Who watched to see which logged-in people watched.

title.tl: Paano buksan o isara ang mga page (Developer)
title.en: How to open or close pages (Developer)

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Lahat bukas para magamit ng lahat ang bawat page.
steps.en: Tap All open so everyone can use every page.

steps.tl: Pangunahin lang: ang mahahalagang page lang ang bukas.
steps.en: Main only: only the important pages stay open.

steps.tl: Eleksyon mode: itinataas ang Presinto at Botohan at isinasara ang hindi kailangan.
steps.en: Election mode: puts Precinct and Voting first and closes what is not needed.

steps.tl: Sa bawat page, piliin kung Lahat, Login, Verified o Off (Malapit na).
steps.en: For each page choose Everyone, Login, Verified or Off (Coming soon).

title.tl: Paano maglagay ng record ng ayuda
title.en: How to add an aid record

steps.tl: Isulat ang control number at buong pangalan ng benepisyaryo.
steps.en: Write the control number and the full name of the beneficiary.

steps.tl: Ilagay ang programa, halimbawa AICS, 4Ps o Senior Pension.
steps.en: Enter the programme, for example AICS, 4Ps or Senior Pension.

steps.tl: Piliin ang status: qualified, scheduled o claimed.
steps.en: Choose the status: qualified, scheduled or claimed.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-save. Makikita na ito ng residente sa Ayuda Checker.
steps.en: Tap Save. The resident can now see it in the Aid Checker.

steps.tl: Maraming tao? I-paste ang listahan (CSV) dito at pindutin ang I-import.
steps.en: Many people? Paste the list (CSV) here and tap Import.

title.tl: Paano gumawa ng batch ng ayuda
title.en: How to make an aid batch

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Bagong batch ng ayuda para ilista ang mga makakatanggap sa isang paglabas ng ayuda. May approval ito ng mga opisyal bago ilabas.
steps.en: Tap New aid batch to list who receives aid in one release. The officials approve it before it goes out.

steps.tl: Piliin ang purok para makita ang mga household doon.
steps.en: Pick a purok to see the households there.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-export bilang CSV para sa census o ulat. Kung may "Posibleng doble" sa itaas (hal. parehong nag-lista ang mag-asawa), pindutin ito, piliin ang household na pananatilihin at pindutin ang Pagsamahin.
steps.en: Tap Export as CSV for the census or a report. If "Posibleng doble" (possible duplicate) shows above, e.g. both spouses made a household, tap it, pick the household to keep and tap Merge.

title.tl: Paano ilista ang Senior, PWD at Solo Parent
title.en: How to list Seniors, PWDs and Solo Parents

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Idagdag para maglagay ng senior, PWD o solo parent.
steps.en: Tap Add to put in a senior, a PWD or a solo parent.

steps.tl: Hanapin ang tao sa pangalan o ID number.
steps.en: Find a person by name or ID number.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang CSV para ma-export ang listahan.
steps.en: Tap CSV to export the list.

title.tl: Paano asikasuhin ang blotter at reklamo
title.en: How to handle blotter and complaints

steps.tl: Sa Bukas makikita ang mga reklamong hindi pa tapos.
steps.en: Under Open you see complaints that are not finished yet.

steps.tl: Sa Tapos na makikita ang mga naayos na.
steps.en: Under Done you see the ones that were settled.

steps.tl: Hanapin ang kaso sa case number, pangalan o purok.
steps.en: Find a case by case number, name or purok.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Bagong proyekto para maglagay ng detalye, badyet, progreso at larawan. Lalabas ito sa Mga Proyekto ng residente.
steps.en: Tap New project to add the details, budget, progress and photos. It shows in the residents' Projects page.

steps.tl: Isulat ang pamagat ng event, halimbawa Clean-up Drive.
steps.en: Write the title of the event, for example Clean-up Drive.

steps.tl: Piliin ang petsa at isulat ang lugar at detalye.
steps.en: Pick the date and write the place and details.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang I-add ang Event. Lalabas ito sa Mga Event ng residente.
steps.en: Tap Add Event. It shows in the residents' Events page.

steps.tl: Sa Naghihintay makikita ang mga pin na inilagay ng residente na kailangan ng approval.
steps.en: Under Waiting you see pins residents added that need approval.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Mag-pin para ikaw mismo ang maglagay ng lugar, halimbawa Evacuation Center.
steps.en: Tap Pin to add a place yourself, for example an Evacuation Center.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Buksan ang mapa para makita ang lahat ng pin.
steps.en: Tap Open the map to see all pins.

steps.tl: Isulat ang tanong, halimbawa Anong araw ang clean-up drive?
steps.en: Write the question, for example Which day is the clean-up drive?

steps.tl: Isulat ang mga pagpipilian, isa bawat linya.
steps.en: Write the choices, one per line.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Gumawa ng Botohan. Verified na residente lang ang makakaboto.
steps.en: Tap Make Poll. Only verified residents can vote.

steps.tl: Sa Chat makikita ang mga mensaheng ni-report ng residente. Burahin o balewalain.
steps.en: Under Chat you see messages residents reported. Delete or dismiss them.

steps.tl: Sa Video makikita ang mga report sa comment ng mga video.
steps.en: Under Video you see reports on video comments.

steps.tl: Sa Naka-mute makikita ang mga naka-mute. Pwede mong alisin ang mute.
steps.en: Under Muted you see who is muted. You can lift the mute.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang +5, +10 o -5 sa purok para dagdagan o bawasan ang points.
steps.en: Tap +5, +10 or -5 on a purok to add or remove points.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang + Clean-up Drive kapag may natapos na clean-up (+20 points).
steps.en: Tap + Clean-up Drive when a clean-up is done (+20 points).

title.en: How to make the monthly report

steps.tl: Piliin ang buwan ng report.
steps.en: Pick the month of the report.

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Gumawa ng report. Pwede itong i-print o i-save bilang PDF.
steps.en: Tap Make report. You can print it or save it as PDF.

title.tl: Paano i-verify ang nanalo sa raffle
title.en: How to verify a raffle winner

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Buksan ang scanner, tapos i-scan ang QR ng nanalo. Lalabas ang Barangay ID niya at kung nakuha na ang premyo.
steps.en: Tap Open scanner, then scan the winner's QR. It shows their Barangay ID and whether the prize was already claimed.

title.en: How to add an important decision

steps.tl: Pindutin ang Bagong desisyon. Dadaan ito sa approval ng mga opisyal bago lumabas sa residente (walang halaga ng pera sa publiko).
steps.en: Tap New decision. It goes through the officials' approval before residents see it (no amount of money is shown publicly).
